long_biography.plain_text:
At Coutts, Robert John Giles spent a decade overseeing discretionary accounts for affluent clients, followed by seven years at Singer & Friedlander. These assignments gave him direct experience evaluating businesses beyond the large-cap mainstream and shaped a research-led approach built around conversations with management teams, balance sheets and trading liquidity.

In 2002, he assembled Volantis within Gartmore, later continuing the operation under Henderson. Lombard Odier acquired the group in 2017, preserving its focus on overlooked UK companies. Giles remains one of the senior decision-makers behind its funds, working alongside Adam McConkey. Outside portfolio work, he joined SourceBio International as a non-executive director, adding board oversight to a career centred on public-market analysis.
